name: Ranged Attack
description: Shoot or throw the readied ranged weapon: d20 + ability modifier + proficiency bonus against the target's Armor Class. A natural 20 always hits and doubles the weapon dice; a natural 1 always misses. Damage is the weapon's dice plus the same ability modifier (DEX, or STR for thrown weapons). Range is the weapon's normal range; long range and cover are adjudicated at the table.

effects.formula: (save.dice.0 == 20 or (save.success and save.dice.0 != 1)) ? roll(ranged.damage) + (save.dice.0 == 20 ? roll(ranged.damage) : 0) + ranged_mod : 0
